text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swinging our swords time and time again,
this scorching summer――comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal faithfully completed all of her training regimens,
finishing her preparations for autumn."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, I am grateful for your kind words...
It is the highest honor.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To receive your orders, carry them out,
and be rewarded with your praise like this...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "To make this moment last forever. That is my one and only wish."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I hope this lasts forever.
Yeah, I hope it stays like this forever.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Naturally, prosperity...
cannot exist without victory.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If you keep losing and tarnishing your honor, that wish will never come true.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However, even if I were to beat Daitaku Helios-san,
and beat Princess Fine, and continue on a winning streak afterwards...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Will the day ever come... when these days come to an end?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if I remain
the greatest and strongest knight forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you keep winning, there's no guarantee
some unforeseen circumstance won't bring an end to it. But...
choice_data_list: I think some things will stay with us forever.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's not like everything will be lost.
Yeah, it's not like everything will be gone

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, everything born from
the time I spent with Durandal
won't just disappear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Glory, footage, or perhaps... deep emotion.
I felt certain that something would endure forever."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my King. Durandal is in awe
of your profound insight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I do not know what that "something" is. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Only after fighting through and winning this autumn will I finally...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you can see it.
What an immortal pride truly means to a knight.
